# dsh-deepseek-cny-cost
**See what the chat you are reading has cost, in CNY, inside the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.**
A small badge sits under the composer next to the session statistics:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The number is the running total for **the chat you are looking at**; switching chats switches the

number, and it grows as the chat works;
- Hovering (or a screen reader) reveals the breakdown: uncac

hed input, cache-hit input, and output tokens, each with its own cost;
- It renders only while the s
elected provider is a DeepSeek official route, because third-party relays are not billed at DeepSeek
's peak / off-peak rates.
## How it prices
It reads two projections the session already exposes and issues no requests of its own:
| Data | Source |
| Token usage | `tokenUsage` (`uncachedInputTokens`, `cacheReadTokens`, `cacheWriteTokens`, `outputT

okens`) |
| Current model | `modelSelection` |
Prices come from the official Models & Pricing page (checked 2026-10), in CNY per million tokens:
| Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output |

| `deepseek-flash` | 0.04 | 2 | 8 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 0.30 | 9 | 27 |
Those are **peak** rates. Off-peak is half of peak; peak is Beijing time Monday–Friday (excluding Ch
inese statutory holidays) 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, and every other hour — weekends and holidays
included — is off-peak.
- Cache writes are billed at the cache-miss input rate, matching DeepSeek's rule that there is no se

parate write fee;
- Legacy names `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` are priced a

s Flash, per the official note;
- An unknown model name **hides the badge** instead of inventing a p

sh, per the official note;
- An unknown model name **hides the badge** instead of inventing a price.
## Known limits
- **An estimate, not an invoice.** It excludes per-request Search / Fetch charges; the official bill

wins.
- **Chats that switched models** are priced with the currently selected model, because `token

Usage` is a whole-chat total with no per-model split.
- **Holidays**: the built-in table covers 2026
. A year without an entry falls back to weekends only, so its holiday weekdays would be priced as pe

ak.
- Shown for DeepSeek official providers (`deepseek-official`, `deepseek-account`, or any new pro
vider id starting with `deepseek`).
